footer.tag: Create beautiful timetables, schedules and planners for classes, work and everyday life. Free, in your browser.

campusInvite.title: SFU, Waterloo, and other schools: send us your timetable file.
campusInvite.body: UBC Workday Excel already imports. If you are at SFU, Waterloo, U of T, McGill, or anywhere else, attach a sample export and we will add the parser so your classmates can import too.
campusInvite.step1: Your school name — SFU, Waterloo, or any campus.
campusInvite.step2: A sample timetable export (Excel, CSV, or the file your portal gives you).
campusInvite.step3: Where you downloaded it — Quest, goSFU, ACORN, Minerva, or similar.
campusInvite.hint: You can strip names and IDs first. A real file is enough for us to add one-click import.
campusInvite.toolHint: Not UBC Workday? Email a sample from SFU, Waterloo, or any campus and we will add it.
